name: stagewalk
pre: game.paused=false; game.clock=21.6; window.__mediaClock=true; window.__gameTimers=true; if(game.mp){ if(game.mp.on) game.mp.leave(); game.mp.name='Natalia'; }
frame: game.paused=false; game.clock=21.6; window.__mediaClock=true; window.__gameTimers=true; if(game.mp){ if(game.mp.on) game.mp.leave(); game.mp.name='Natalia'; } const P=game.player, dm=Math.hypot(P.x-420,P.y+1194); if(!game.stageMic()){ if(dm>2.0){ P.h=Math.PI; dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{code:'KeyW'})); } else { dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{code:'KeyW'})); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{code:'KeyE'})); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{code:'KeyE'})); } } else if(!window.__sk){ window.__sk=1; game.music.el.currentTime=62.3; }
